title: membrane-brain: a brain-shaped toy for a holographic-membrane associative memory with a refusal gate (synthetic)
description: Synthetic, stdlib-only Python toy: 128 seeded neurons in two ellipses, four stored wave fields, a one-shot outer-product associative memory and a frozen refusal gate. It is not a brain, not neuroscience and not a medical or clinical tool. The repository documents measured behaviour and limits, including negative results.
